source.note: English wording checked against Sahih International at the cited source. Arabic must remain byte-for-byte identical to the approved Tanzil reference.

verses.english: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].
And to your Lord direct [your] longing.

audio.pauses_treatment: user_approved_preview_v4; trim trailing low-level silence using silenceremove stop_duration=0.08 stop_threshold=-42dB; insert only 0.02 seconds between verses; no time-stretching or speed change
audio.note: Review-only candidate for Ash-Sharh 94:5-8. This recording has not been separately listened to or approved. It may be rendered only as a private review preview, never treated as production-approved.

readability_constraints.arabic: One large centered Arabic verse per screen; wrap by whole words if needed; preserve exact Unicode text byte-for-byte; no clipping or overlap; keep the separate ornamental verse-number medallion.
readability_constraints.english: Show only the matching English translation beneath its verse; wrap by measured font width; no clipping.
readability_constraints.collision_checks: Measure all text bounds; fail rendering if any text crosses panel boundaries, overlaps another verse, or collides with title/ornament.
readability_constraints.basmala: Display separately from verse text; never append it to verse 1.

caption.arabic:
سورة الشرح | الآيات 5–8
تلاوة لسورة الشرح، تذكيرٌ باليسر بعد العسر وبالتوجّه إلى الله.
caption.english:
Surah Ash-Sharh | Verses 5–8
A recitation from Surah Ash-Sharh, a reminder of ease after hardship and turning to Allah.
